research.summary: Archive acquisition/extraction is a fail-closed network-independent core. ORACC publishes no authenticated checksum, so previously unseen bytes require two independent fetch streams with identical byte length and SHA-256. Project roots are derived from internal metadata.json location plus declared pathname/project, including three-level projects; live HTTP/TLS ownership remains outside PH3.

design.boundary: Bounded stream-to-temp acquisition, two-fetch corroboration, ZIP structural/resource preflight, portable path validation, structure-derived ORACC project roots, identity-bound manual staged extraction, atomic destination publication, and cleanup only. No live HTTP client, discovery policy, lock mutation, source diff, rebuild, or release publication.
design.security_contract: Reject unsafe/non-portable paths, duplicate/casefold/prefix aliases, symlinks and special files, encryption, unsupported compression, classic-ZIP structural inconsistencies, member/aggregate/ratio resource exhaustion, transformed raw names, source-byte identity changes, and extraction length disagreement before publishing any destination tree. Direct/pinned preflight applies the configured archive-byte ceiling before ZipFile central-directory materialization, metadata decompression uses bounded reads and verifies declared length, and ZIP64 requires an explicit research/design update rather than silent widening.

reground.result: The PH3 branch was re-grounded as a two-parent merge onto current main while preserving only the seven PH3-owned implementation/evidence files; comparison reports zero commits behind main before final evidence/CI.

behavior.acquisition: Download chunks are byte-capped while written once and hashed; unseen bytes are accepted only after two independently supplied streams agree in length and SHA-256; mismatch or second-fetch failure cleans temporary copies.
behavior.preflight: Before ZipFile materialization, the on-disk archive size is checked against max_download_bytes, classic ZIP EOCD facts are bounded-read, and the central directory is sequentially scanned and member-capped. Scanned count is cross-checked against EOCD and materialized entries; hybrid/ordinary ZIP64 and multidisk inputs fail closed pending explicit research; malformed filename decoding and zipfile raw-name transformation remain typed structure failures; metadata.json is decompressed with bounded reads and its actual length must equal declared ZIP metadata.
behavior.paths: Member/project components require NFC relative POSIX paths and reject traversal, backslashes, Windows forbidden characters, trailing dot/space, ordinary and superscript-digit Win32 reserved device names, casefold aliases at full-path and ancestor-prefix levels, and file/directory prefix collisions.
behavior.extraction: Extraction is bound to the bytes that were actually preflighted rather than reopening a mutable caller path. Verified two-fetch state is rechecked against the exact SHA-256/length before extraction; source replacement/tampering fails closed. Members are manually copied into an isolated sibling staging tree with actual decompressed-byte accounting; destination publication is one final rename and failed staging/snapshot files are removed.

independent_review.result: Successive logically-independent reviews found resource-boundary and byte-identity/TOCTOU blockers. Every finding was converted into RED-first regression coverage and fixed on later runtime heads. This evidence update deliberately does not self-certify final review: exact-head CI and a fresh logically-independent security review of the final evidence head remain mandatory.

completion_blocker.reason: PH3's network-independent security core is implemented and tested, but completion requires integration with PH2's discovery/download transport path; PH2 itself remains completion-blocked by PH1 normal-TLS upstream acquisition. No TLS verification may be weakened to satisfy this dependency.

resume_gate: After PH2/PH1 authenticated transport is available, connect the real downloaded archive stream to acquire_unseen/preflight/extract without relaxing any fail-closed rule, exercise representative active RIAO/RINAP inputs plus a three-level project, record integration evidence, then run exact-head CI and a fresh independent security review before marking P-002.PH3 done.
